cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.87%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.32%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +9.42%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +9.42%, VRT +6.57%, OKLO +5.24%, EOSE +5.18%, LEU +5.12%. Laggards: NEE -0.74%, MPC -0.26%, MPLX -0.19%, ETR -0.13%.
